name: Memory Extract
description: Extracts memories from incoming messages and stores them in the PostgreSQL memory database

summaryIntervalMs.description: Milliseconds between periodic summary log lines (default 30 min)

stallThresholdMs.description: Milliseconds without a successful store before a stall warning fires (default 6 h)

stallRepeatIntervalMs.description: Minimum milliseconds between repeat stall warnings while stalled (default 1 h)

dbUnresolvedRateLimitMs.description: Minimum milliseconds between db_unresolved log lines after startup (default 10 min)
